segments.ja463:1.3: Suppārakaṃ taṃ pucchāma, samuddo katamo ayaṃ.
segments.ja463:2.1: Kurukacchā [bharukacchā (sī. syā. pī. aṭṭha.)] payātānaṃ, vāṇijānaṃ dhanesinaṃ;
segments.ja463:3.1: Yathā aggīva suriyova [aggi suriyo ca (syā.), aggīva sūriyo (ka.)], samuddo paṭidissati;
segments.ja463:3.3: Suppārakaṃ taṃ pucchāma, samuddo katamo ayaṃ.
segments.ja463:5.1: Yathā dadhīva khīraṃva [dadhi ca khīraṃ ca (syā.), evamuparipi], samuddo paṭidissati;
segments.ja463:5.3: Suppārakaṃ taṃ pucchāma, samuddo katamo ayaṃ.
segments.ja463:7.3: Suppārakaṃ taṃ pucchāma, samuddo katamo ayaṃ.
segments.ja463:9.3: Suppārakaṃ taṃ pucchāma, samuddo katamo ayaṃ.
segments.ja463:11.1: Mahabbhayo bhiṃsanako, saddo suyyatimānuso [samuddo suyyata’ mānuso (sī. pī. aṭṭha.)];
segments.ja463:11.5: Suppārakaṃ taṃ pucchāma, samuddo katamo ayaṃ.
segments.ja463:12.3: Nāvāya vippanaṭṭhāya, baḷavāmukhīti [vaḷabhāmukhīti (sī. syā.), balavāmukhīti (syā. ka.)] vuccati.
segments.ja463:13.1: Yato sarāmi attānaṃ, yato pattosmi viññutaṃ;
segments.ja463:17.3: Atha pāni yudhañcayako ca, dasaratha saṃvara pāragatena navāti.
